catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds a publication of opendrone/PlannerOutput to a world.sim resource. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 requires a robot.arm resource and a reached pose; cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 takes a velocity and duration and returns distance/heading; the base node simply latches the first position-valid point and republishes a setpoint, so a rosbridge publish receipt is transmission-only. The extension preserves that native topic.

No catalogue class fits the fixed std_srvs/SetBool /land request. cap.motion.stop.v1 requires a deceleration profile and a stopped result; /land only acknowledges the landing request and the node then requests AUTO.LAND, so reporting stopped=true would be invented.
catalogue_requests.summary: Fixed, input-free request to the base node's /land service.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class reads geometry_msgs/PoseStamped from /mavros/setpoint_position/local on a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu or sensor.force_torque resources; this is a simulator setpoint observation, and it is explicit because the base node stops publishing the topic in LANDING/LANDED.
catalogue_requests.summary: Read one /mavros/setpoint_position/local sample from the base node.

notes:
Blocked on SDK_BUG (BL-17). Evidence state none: the gate fails G6 and G8 (earlier contract_checked results are historical). No hardware, live ROS graph, rosbridge, PX4 SITL, Gazebo or MAVROS run is claimed. The gate fails G6 and G8 because a ROS 1 producer stamp is not a freshness proof. Gate digest sha256:c4383bf8296a4aa9fd65acb6ce1a839780d82dec7d0d615c79bcd62d4ae138c4. The pinned clone states no fixed workspace bound: the base node's geo fence is built from the ROS parameters geo_fence/x, geo_fence/y and geo_fence/z (opendrone/src/base.cpp:43-45), so a default value is not a device bound and an operator must configure and verify the fence. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. 

SCOPE: configuration-only RosDriver for the opendrone base node, no Python native class and no upstream import or execution. The primary control is a publication of opendrone/PlannerOutput to /planner/output; the base node selects the first point whose valid_mask has VALID_POSITION (1) and republishes its position (and yaw when VALID_YAW (32) is set) as geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on /mavros/setpoint_position/local at its configured rate. The receipt reports published=true and confirmed=false; a ROS topic publication has no execution acknowledgement. Resource reads are /flight_state (std_msgs/Int8), /mavros/state (mavros_msgs/State: connected, armed, mode) and /mavros/local_position/pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped: position). /mavros/setpoint_position/local is exposed as the explicit observation x-cap.tfly6.setpoint.v1, not as an automatic resource field: the base node publishes it only in WAITING_FOR_OFFBOARD, [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Traced the declared stop: safety_bindings.estop and the safe_state=True action were /land (std_srvs/SetBool true), whose callback stores landing_locked_ and LANDING and returns success unconditionally without calling MAVROS (base.cpp:277-289); the 50 Hz control loop then asks /mavros/set_mode for AUTO.LAND and enters LANDED once the call reports mode_sent (162-164, 259-275), and LANDED only logs a disarm (166-170), so nothing senses the mode change, touchdown or disarm. A callback acknowledgement of a LAND mode request is not a stop, yet the SDK reported the e-stop completed. The reviewer removed the binding and safe_state=True (/land stays an ordinary command), rewrote safe_state, the docstring and the stop gaps, corrected six facts and added three, and removed a top-level time_from_start that opendrone/PlannerOutput lacks (PlannerOutput.msg:1-7; it is a point field), which rosbridge would refuse on every /planner/output publication (driver.py); replaced the /land e-stop cases with one expecting MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, no upstream call, the latch held and /land refused, plus declaration and message-field checks (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate now fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 (one missing stop at R2, as in the sjtu_drone review), the nine package cases pass, and collect.py reports RESULT_UNTRUSTED until the orchestrator writes status blocked; the author's notes above still describe /land as the e-stop. For the human reviewer: PX4 SITL by default, but the base node is FCU-agnostic: sitl_base_controller.launch enables automatic OFFBOARD, arming and takeoff, and px4.launch points MAVROS at a serial PX4 (/dev/ttyACM0:57600). An MHS e-stop now calls nothing upstream and, while latched, refuses /land too; the node keeps streaming its latched setpoint. Target positions have no envelope (geo fence 10/10/7 by default, 50/50/7 in the SITL launch). Unblocking needs a stop with a sensed outcome, such as /land followed by a confirmed AUTO.LAND mode and a landed or disarmed state.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): PASS after repair; the blocked text above is historical and superseded. The /land acknowledgement alone is still not a stop (2026-11-04); under the user's decision of 2026-11-05 (simulated devices only) the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, MHS/changes/SENSED-CONFIRMATION-STOP.md): it sends /land {data: true} (base.cpp:32, 277-289) and a /mavros/cmd/arming disarm (the node's client, base.cpp:30; refused in the air, repeated by the retry), and is achieved only when /mavros/state reads connected and not armed (consumed at base.cpp:127, 167) and /mavros/local_position/pose reads z below the landed band and x, y, z still (base.cpp:341-343). /flight_state is never a source (LANDED on mode_sent alone). The confirmation counts only new subscriptions opened after the request (first sample discarded, strictly increasing producer stamps, three consecutive samples within the 1500 ms fake bound); every threshold is operator_required (fake placeholders in fixtures/estop-confirmation.json; a live simulation supplies them and its own client bounds in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation']). The landing lock stops the node's own OFFBOARD and arming requests (base.cpp:209-213, 234-238). Dual use disclosed: sitl_config/px4.launch:5 defaults fcu_url to a serial device. Changed driver.py (sensed_stop, safe_state, estop_latency_ms 3500, six facts, gaps), fake.py (stamped bursts, placeholder descent and auto-disarm, switches), fixtures/estop-confirmation.json (new), test_driver.py (old stop cases replaced, nine sensed cases, check_driver kept), facts.md, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json, RESULT.json. G1-G9 pass, contract_checked; G6 SENSED_FAIL_OPEN (withheld, frozen, nulled samples) leaves the e-stop unachieved and latched. Source pin, DeepSeek attribution and null reviewed_by unchanged. No ROS graph, simulator, MAVROS, PX4 or hardware ran.
